class: A CI step that installs system packages with apt on a hosted runner can spend its whole timeout on one stalled mirror download, because apt's default per-request timeout is long and it retries the same slow fetch; the job fails red with no code defect, and a re-run is the only recovery unless apt is told to fail over fast.
mechanism: `npx playwright install-deps chromium` runs apt-get; a fetch from azure.archive.ubuntu.com stalls (log shows `Ign:` then the same `Get:` again) and the step hits timeout-minutes 12.

first_seen.where: PR #525 app-tests frontend job, run 39950471622 (d99b2097), step 'Install Playwright system deps only (cache hit)'
first_seen.evidence: log tail: Ign:7 / Ign:9 / Ign:13 on noble mirrors, then '##[error]The action ... has timed out after 12 minutes.'

fix: Fix 1 (3cb151da, short apt timeouts and retries) did NOT hold: the timeout counts only silence and the mirror method fails over per file, so every index file still waited on the Azure mirror first (run 39972212143: Ign on azure for InRelease and 6 Packages/Translation files, then the 12-minute timeout). Second occurrence -> independent review (Sonnet, fresh): the defect is the runner's `mirror+file:/etc/apt/apt-mirrors.txt` source list putting Azure first for every file. Fix 2: a step before the Playwright installs rewrites /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources (and sources.list) to http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/ and fails if any mirror-list entry survives. The review's first choice (skip apt when `install-deps --dry-run` shows nothing missing) was not taken: the flag is unverified and output parsing adds a failure mode. Remaining risk: Canonical's archive itself slow.

detection.note: The repo test asserts every job with a `playwright install` step has an earlier sources-rewrite step that proves itself (`! grep`); red on the fix-1 workflow (flags frontend and execute-screen-e2e), green on fix 2. Not covered: whether the archive is reachable on a given run - the next CI run is the proof.

occurrences.evidence: timed out after 12 minutes on apt downloads

occurrences.where: PR #525 run 39972212143 (1a349d52), frontend job, AFTER fix 1
occurrences.evidence: Ign:2-5 azure InRelease twice, Hit:2 https://archive.ubuntu.com, then Ign:10-15 azure Packages/Translation, then timed out after 12 minutes
